mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_coupon c JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=c.template_id WHERE c.user_id=#{actor} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT u.id, c.id AS coupon_id, t.template_name AS coupon_name, u.checkout_batch_id AS batch_id, u.payment_order_id AS payment_id, u.discount_amount_fen AS discount_fen, u.usage_status AS status, u.used_at, u.return_confirmed_at AS returned_at FROM coupon_usage u JOIN user_coupon c ON c.id=u.user_coupon_id JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=c.template_id WHERE u.user_id=#{actor} AND u.usage_status IN ('used', 'returned') ORDER BY COALESCE(u.return_confirmed_at, u.used_at) DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_usage WHERE user_id=#{actor} AND usage_status IN ('used', 'returned')
